Name: Image Slideshow
Description: Automatically resizes local images and adds clock, weather, or system-resource screens for the Ulanzi D200.
Overview: Center-crop local images to 458 x 196 without changing the originals; rotate clock, weather, CPU/GPU/RAM screens.
Author: Santiago Pérez

Actions.Name: Image Slideshow
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate auto-fitted local images with optional clock, WeatherAPI forecast, and CPU/GPU/RAM panels.

Actions.Name: Setup Large Display
Actions.Tooltip: Guided install, repair, or restore for the D200 large display.

Detail:
Image Slideshow turns the Ulanzi D200 center display into a rotating local image gallery, localized clock, optional WeatherAPI forecast, and CPU/GPU/RAM monitor.

Core features:
1. Center-crops PNG, JPG, JPEG, and SVG images to the D200 458 x 196 display without modifying the original files.
2. Rotates images in order or shuffled mode and watches the selected folder for changes.
3. Adds optional date/time, weather forecast, and system-resource screens with independent durations.
4. Works offline for images, clock, and system resources; weather uses the user's own WeatherAPI key.
5. Includes Setup Large Display for guided install, repair, restore, backup, validation, and rollback.

Compatibility: Ulanzi D200 on Windows x64 and macOS x64/arm64 with Ulanzi Studio 3.0.11 or later. macOS users may need to reopen Ulanzi Studio manually after setup. GPU utilization is best-effort and may show N/A when the operating system or driver does not expose it.
